☁️ Cloudflare Pages Deployment Guide

Deploy your static website in ~15 minutes — no credit card, no server, no ICP filing required

What You'll Get

✅ Global CDN · ✅ Automatic HTTPS · ✅ Custom domain · ✅ Free tier (unlimited bandwidth)
Your domain holgenvy.com — images, CSS, JS all load normally in the browser.

1

Create a Cloudflare Account

  1. Go to dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up
  2. Sign up with your email (free plan is sufficient)
  3. Verify your email address
💡 No credit card required. The Free plan includes unlimited websites, unlimited bandwidth, and automatic SSL.
2

Add Your Domain to Cloudflare

  1. After logging in, click "Add a Site" (blue button)
  2. Enter holgenvy.com and click "Add Site"
  3. Select the Free plan and click "Continue"
  4. Cloudflare will scan your existing DNS records — they will appear automatically
  5. Click "Continue" to proceed
📋 The scanned DNS records will be listed here (e.g. A records for your current IP).
Keep them as-is unless you know what you're changing.
3

Change Nameservers at Your Domain Registrar

Cloudflare will show you two nameserver addresses, for example:

dahlia.ns.cloudflare.com
rory.ns.cloudflare.com
  1. Your domain is registered at Alibaba Cloud (万网/阿里云)
  2. Log in to Alibaba Cloud Domain Console
  3. Find holgenvy.com → click "Manage" (管理)
  4. Click "Change DNS Servers" (修改DNS)
  5. Select "Custom DNS" (自定义DNS)
  6. Enter the two Cloudflare nameservers you got above
  7. Click "Confirm" (确认)
⚠️ DNS changes take a few minutes to 24 hours to propagate worldwide. Cloudflare will email you when it's active. You can proceed to Step 4 while waiting — it won't affect setup.
4

Deploy Your Site to Cloudflare Pages

Option A: Connect a Git Repository (Recommended)

  1. In Cloudflare Dashboard, go to Workers & Pages → Pages (left sidebar)
  2. Click "Create a project" → "Connect to Git"
  3. Authorize Cloudflare with your GitHub or GitLab account
  4. Select the repository containing your website files
  5. Under "Build settings":
    • Project name: holgenvy (or any name)
    • Production branch: main (or master)
    • Build command: leave blank (for static HTML sites)
    • Build output directory: leave blank (or / if your files are in root)
  6. Click "Save and Deploy"

⏳ Wait ~30 seconds — Cloudflare will clone your repo and deploy it.

Option B: Upload Files Directly

  1. In Cloudflare Dashboard, go to Workers & Pages → Pages
  2. Click "Create a project" → "Direct Upload"
  3. Drag & drop your entire website folder (.html, .css, .js, images, etc.)
  4. Click "Deploy"
💡 Option B is great for one-time deployments. For ongoing updates, use Option A (Git) — every push to your repo triggers an automatic redeploy.
📸 After deployment, you'll see a success page with a *.pages.dev URL (e.g. holgenvy.pages.dev).
Your site is already live at that URL — test it before adding your custom domain.
5

Bind Your Custom Domain

  1. In your Pages project page, click the "Custom domains" tab
  2. Click "Set up a custom domain" (or "Add custom domain")
  3. Enter holgenvy.com and click "Continue"
  4. Cloudflare will automatically add the required DNS records
  5. Wait a moment for SSL provisioning (green lock appears automatically)
  6. Optionally add www.holgenvy.com the same way
⚠️ Make sure the proxied cloud (☁️ orange) is enabled on the DNS record — this ensures HTTPS works and Cloudflare's CDN is active.
6

Verify Everything Works

  1. Open your browser and visit https://holgenvy.com
  2. Check that all pages load correctly
  3. Check that images display normally (right-click → "Open image in new tab" should show the image directly)
  4. If something is broken, check the "Deployments" tab in Cloudflare Pages for any build errors
  5. Use browser DevTools (F12) → Network tab to see if any resources fail
💡 SSL certificate is issued automatically by Cloudflare. It usually takes about 30-60 seconds after binding the domain.

Quick Reference

Step What to Do Time
1 Create Cloudflare account 2 min
2 Add holgenvy.com to Cloudflare 3 min
3 Change nameservers at Alibaba Cloud 5 min
4 Deploy site to Cloudflare Pages 3 min

FAQ

Do I need ICP filing (备案)?

No. Cloudflare Pages is a global service — no ICP filing is required.

Will images load normally?

Yes. Cloudflare does not add Content-Disposition: attachment headers like Alibaba Cloud's default domain does. Images, CSS, and JavaScript will all work as expected.

What about page speed in China?

Cloudflare's free plan routes traffic through overseas nodes. Speed is generally acceptable for content sites, but not as fast as a domestic CDN. If performance becomes critical later, you can add a China-based CDN after filing.

Can I still use uniCloud as a backend?

Yes. Keep your uniCloud cloud functions as API endpoints (accessed via the default domain or a CNAME), and use Cloudflare Pages to serve the frontend (HTML + CSS + JS + images). They work independently of each other.

What if I change my code later?

If using Git: just push your changes and Cloudflare redeploys automatically (usually within 1 minute). If using Direct Upload: simply upload the new files.
